name: Scope Metals Group Ltd.
summary: Scope Metals Group Ltd. stores, processes, and delivers metal and plastic worldwide. The company supplies aluminum, stainless steel, steel, plastic materials, copper, bronze, brass, titanium, zinc, lead, tungsten, magnesium, and other raw materials.
